result:
The form now saves BMI as a server-side observation, and older encounters fall back to the browser calculation. I could not find a ticket key for this change, and I did not verify the server-side interpretation logic.

**What the form stores.** On save, the form computes BMI from weight and height and writes it as a `bodyMassIndex` obs. On create it always adds one. On edit it voids the previous BMI obs and adds a new one only when weight or height changed. The BMI field is never included in the other field-to-obs mapping (`prepareObsForSubmission`), which is why it has its own block (`openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-vitals-app/src/vitals-biometrics-form/exported-vitals-biometrics-form.workspace.tsx:186-223`). The BMI value is computed in the same file at lines 138-157, using the unit-aware helper in `vitals-biometrics-form.utils.ts:4-27`. The form schema accepts it as a number (`schema.ts:15`).

**How the listing reads it.** The biometrics fetch maps the `bodyMassIndexUuid` concept to a `bmi` key (`data.resource.ts:289-290`), and the concept is now part of the query (`data.resource.ts:189`). Each encounter prefers its persisted BMI obs and its interpretation. Only if no BMI obs exists does it fall back to the client-side calculation (`data.resource.ts:361-367`). That fallback is how older encounters still show a value. The row type carries `bmi` and `bmiRenderInterpretation` (`types.ts:116-117`, `biometrics/types.ts:11`).

**Change and ticket.** The listing change is commit `d4857fbf84af21943b989c91c1b37277ff3ff2fd`, "(feat) Surface BMI reference ranges in the biometrics table (#3238)", by Dennis Kigen, 2026-04-17. Its diff is the `data.resource.ts` change above, adding the BMI concept to the query, the `bmi` mapping, the persisted-first fallback and the interpretation field. The commit message has no ticket key. I searched for one and found none linked to this change, so I have not cited a ticket.

**Not verified.** I did not find the openmrs-core code that computes the interpretation from concept reference ranges, so the claim that the server judges BMI is from the code comment at `data.resource.ts:362`, not from code I read. I also did not find the earlier commit that first added BMI persistence to the form. The form history I listed touches the workspace file but none of its commits is clearly that one.
